headline: bKash manager shot and Tk3C looted in Sreepur
summary: A bKash manager was shot and injured during a robbery in Sreepur, Gazipur, where criminals made off with Tk3 crore. Police are investigating the incident.
details: A bKash manager was shot and seriously injured in Sreepur, Gazipur, during a daring daylight robbery. The incident occurred when criminals targeted the manager, making off with a significant amount of cash.

The assailants reportedly looted approximately Tk3 crore from the bKash manager. The motive appears to be the large sum of money being transported. The manager sustained gunshot wounds and was rushed to a local hospital for immediate medical attention.

Police have launched an investigation into the shooting and robbery. Security forces are reviewing CCTV footage and gathering information to identify and apprehend the perpetrators. The incident has raised concerns about security in the area, particularly for financial transactions.

headline_marked: 9 in 10 [[Bangladeshis with mental health conditions go untreated]]
headline: 9 in 10 Bangladeshis with mental health conditions go untreated
summary: A staggering gap in mental health care access remains a critical issue in the country.
details: Approximately 90% of people in Bangladesh suffering from mental health conditions do not receive any professional treatment.
This massive treatment gap highlights a severe shortage of mental health professionals and a lack of accessibility to care.
The lack of treatment often stems from social stigma, lack of awareness, and limited resources in the public health system.
Experts suggest that early intervention and better integration of mental health services into primary healthcare are essential to address this crisis.
